summary: Iteration 10 — verified the AuthContext.js logout console.warn change has no regressions. Backend: 6/6 auth logout regression tests PASSED (login sets cookies, logout returns 200, both cookies cleared with Max-Age=0, /auth/me and /accounts return 401 after logout, fresh login after logout works). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright verified — admin login redirected to /, current-user-email shows admin@sherlock.app, click logout-btn redirects to /login, browser cookies cleared, protected route / redirects back to /login. No behavioral regression; console.warn only fires on server-side failure (did not fire in happy path, as expected).
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.js logout change is minimal and correct — logs a warning and still clears local session, matching the intent of the review. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scoped verification of AuthContext.js logout change only. Full backend suite (16 tests, iter9) not re-run per request. Prior test files: /app/backend/tests/test_connections_bugfix.py, backend_test.py, conftest.py. Auth cookies are httpOnly+secure+samesite=none. Logout endpoint requires auth cookie (uses Depends(current_user)) — calling POST /auth/logout without a cookie returns 401 by design.
rca of the issue: N/A — non-behavioral code change (empty catch block replaced with console.warn). Verified server response and UI logout flow are unchanged.
